Gotham Independent Film Awards 2004 | The 14th Annual Gotham Independent Film Awards were held on December 1, 2004.  The nominees for Breakthrough Actor and Director were announced on November 1, 2004 and the nominees in the film categories were announced on November 10, 2004.  It was the first Gotham Award ceremony where the prizes for Best Feature and Best Documentary were awarded.  The ceremony was hosted by Bob Balaban.
Gotham Independent Film Awards 2016 | The 26th Annual Gotham Awards, one of the Gotham Independent Film Awards hosted by the Independent Filmmaker Project, were held on November 28, 2016.  The nominees were announced on October 20, 2016.  Actors Ethan Hawke and Amy Adams, director Oliver Stone and producer Arnon Milchan received tribute awards.  The ceremony was hosted by Keegan-Michael Key.

Gotham Independent Film Awards 2009 | The 19th Annual Gotham Independent Film Awards were held on November 30, 2009.  The nominees were announced on October 19, 2009.  The ceremony was hosted by Kumail Nanjiani.
Gotham Independent Film Awards 2005 | The 15th Annual Gotham Independent Film Awards were held on November 30, 2005.  The nominees were announced on October 25, 2005.  The ceremony was hosted by Kyra Sedgwick.
